name: Reza Zomorrodi
abstract_title: (Bidirectional Control Energy: A Breakthrough Objective Metric for Measuring Elevated Consciousness and Probing Quantum Theories, Validated by Photobiomodulation in Expert Meditators
abstract: Abstract: We introduce BiCE (Bidirectional Control Energy)—Kc (subcortical→cortical) and Ks (cortical→subcortical)—as a breakthrough, fully objective biomarker for elevated consciousness. Derived from Network Control Theory applied to conventional EEG, BiCE quantifies the minimum control effort required to sustain stable brain states across cortical-subcortical loops.
